The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses - This tender enquiry is for the total projected requirement of 485 Ton of the material. The offers w ill be techno-commercially evaluated for the entire quantity. However, the price discovery & R A against this bid will be done for 240 Ton quantity. - For the balance quantity, after finalization of the order for the current lot of 240 Ton (Lot-1), subs equent price discovery will be done on requirement basis, for which, the bidders who are found te chno-commercially suitable against this tender will remain techno-commercially suitable. Such tec hno-commercially suitable bidders will only submit new price bids. - In case any new bidder(s) are interested to participate after opening of this bid, all such bidders will be given the opportunity to submit their techno-commercial bids subsequently against extensi on tender(s) for the balance quantities. I. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA i. The firm should be a manufacturer/ supplier of liquid ammonia.* ii. Average annual financial turnover during last 3 years ending on 31st March of previous financial year (ie., upto FY2025-26) should be atleast Rs. 115.87 Lakhs. Audited annual report (balance she et and profit & loss account) with valid UDIN are to be submitted. iii. Firm must have supplied (in single or multiple orders) minimum 600 Ton of liquid ammonia to a ny Govt. Organisation/ PSU/ public limited/ private limited company during consecutive 12 months any one of last 7 years ending last day of month previous to the one in which tenders are invited. Order copies and documentary proof of supply to be submitted (in case tenderer has supplied req uired quantity to SAIL-RSP during the above period, they shall only mention purchase order no, dat e, quantity and Invoice no, date & quantity). * Relevant documentary evidence is to be submitted - in case the bidder is a manufacturer of liqui d ammonia, the bidder will be required to submit relevant documents to prove the manufacturer st atus. In case the bidder is participating as a supplier, valid authorization from the OEM may be sub mitted in support. ** Non-submission of the documents towards fulfillment of eligibility criteria of the bid as listed ab ove, during bid submission, may lead to rejection of the bid. II. SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS 1) The tenderer must accept the tendered specification. Offer(s) not confirming to tender specifica tion shall be summarily rejected. 2) The supplier should ensure that the ammonia tankers & crew should have valid license to transport Liquid ammonia before loading. The driver of the vehicle should carry Transport Emerge ncy card (TREM Card) issued by the supplier / employer including the important instructions to be followed by him/ her. 3) Necessary safety precautions are to be taken during loading of the tankers. 4) The delivery of liquid anhydrous ammonia shall be in multiples of full tanker capacity and within the order qty. Any remaining quantity that has not been delivered due to tanker capacity limitatio ns will be foreclosed. The bidder may indicate the size of tankers to be used for supply of material. 5) The delivery of the material shall commence within five days of contract placement, unless com

municated otherwise by SAIL-RSP. Subsequent material supply will be as per SAIL-RSP requiremen t & shall be communicated to the supplier by SAIL-RSP. Any change in delivery pattern will be com municated to the supplier by SAIL-RSP, within 1 week in advance. 6) Bidders to offer delivery terms - FOR RSP Stores; freight and insurance to be borne by the suppl ier, without any charges to RSP. No detention charge will be applicable. 7) Since weighment result of one Weigh Bridge differs from another weigh bridge, the lowest weig ht (i.e. weight at SAIL-RSP weigh bridge and invoice weight) will be considered for payment. 8) The material should confirm to specification & should lead to satisfactory performance in Synth esis gas plant, SSM. Material test certificate (MTC) is to be submitted with each consignment. 9) Material is to be unloaded at SSM site of SAIL-RSP. 10) Price variation clause: Firm till delivery. 11) Payment term: 100% against GARN (Material acceptance) within 10 days (as per GeM). 12) SAIL-RSP reserves the right to fore-close the order with 15 days prior intimation to the supplier . 13) In case of requirement, the order quantity may be increased by upto 25% within the tenure of the contract and the order validity shall be extended accordingly, unilaterally by SAIL-RSP, with th e same terms and conditions of the contract. Bidders will be required to confirm acceptance of the above in the techno-commercial offer. III. COMMERCIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS:- 1. Applicable GST, HSN Code of Material, GSTN shall be quoted clearly. 2. The following may be noted regarding techno-commercial evaluation and price discovery:- (a) The techno-commercial bids will remain valid for 12 months (360 days) from the date of te nder opening. The techno-commercial offers of the eligible bidders against this bid shall be fro zen for the balance tendered quantity. The price bids will remain valid for 60 days. (b) SAIL-RSP reserves the right to discover the price, through Reverse Auction (RA), among the techno-commercially qualified bidders. (c) The total projected requirement of the material is 485 Ton. The offers against this bid will b e techno-commercially evaluated for the entire quantity of 485 Ton. The price discovery & RA against this bid, however will be done for 240 Ton quantity (Lot #1). (d) The prices discovered will remain firm for the corresponding phase of delivery as per the G eM contract. (e) The RA will be conducted as per GeM RA procedure. (f) Since the offer submission and price discovery will be done through GeM portal,t he prices quoted will be on landed cost basis, inclusive of GST and all taxes/ duties (unless otherwise sp ecified in Special Terms of ATC). 3. Bidders are required to submit EMD as stipulated above. IV. DELIVERY REQUIREMENT: 1. The requirement of liquid anhydrous Ammonia is approximately 70-80 Ton/month. The effective storage capacity at SSM site is approximately 100 Ton. The delivery of material will be done throu gh road tankers. 2. The delivery of the material shall commence (tentatively) within five days of contract placement , unless communicated otherwise by SAIL-RSP. 3. Subsequent material supply will be regulated by SAIL-RSP, to maintain safety stock of 25 Ton at SSM site. Any change in delivery pattern will be communicated to the supplier by SAIL-RSP, one w eek in advance. V. GUARANTEE CLAUSE: MTC is to be submitted with each consignment. The material should co nfirm to specification & should lead to satisfactory performance in the Synthesis Gas plant, SSM. VI. PRICE VARIATION CLAUSE: Firm till delivery. VII. INSPECTION TERM: 1. Inspection shall be done by Area In-charge, ACU, SSM, at site, after receipt. 2. Material data, safety data & GC/ TC are to be submitted by the supplier along with each consign ment. 3. Acceptance of the material shall be based on GC/TC of each consignment. BIDDERS TO NOTE: 1. Bidder(s) must submit filled Annexure-A, Annexure-B (Format for undertaking by the bidder) & A

nnexure-S (details of supporting documents for verification), along with the offer. Formats attache d in the bid document. 2.a. For all such participatin g bidders, it is mandatory to submit adequate documentation to establish their status as Class I/ C lass II Local supplier. The bidder(s) shall submit an undertaking declaring the percentage of local c ontent for the materials quoted in the bid. Any technical query/ clarification, is to be routed through the pre-bid representation functionalit y available against this bid. vii. Risk purchase (RPN) clause: Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, if the Supplier neglects or fails to perform the Agreement by the time or times agreed upon, for any reas on other than Force Majeure, the Purchaser after having come to know of such negligence or non- performance, after giving 14 to 30 days’ notice or any such extended period that the Supplier and Purchaser may mutually agree, to the Supplier to rectify, shall take such action as it considers fit i ncluding but not limited to taking risk purchase action for supply of the material, mitigating any lo sses, at the risk and cost of the Supplier as far as the undelivered quantity in that Delivery Period i s concerned. The Right of the Purchaser for Risk Purchase Action is in addition to the Right of Purc haser to terminate the Contract due to the fault of the Supplier. The price differential in case of hig her cost to SAIL, if any, shall have to be borne by the defaulting Supplier. Moreover, the defaulting Supplier shall have no claim over the quantity, which they failed to supply. viii. Before dispatching the material, seller(s) must ensure the following:- a. GeM contract is duly accepted. b. GeM fees has been paid (if any, for contract acceptance)

c. GeM contract should remain valid till receipt of material at consignee location. d. Invoices have been created in GeM, confirming dispatch of material ix. SAIL-RSP will be placing back-up order against GeM contract(s) on successful bidder(s). SAIL-RS P’s back-up purchase order, however, will be released only after acceptance of contract by seller i n GeM. Further, non-compliance of the requisites in “viii” & “ix”, shall be at the risk of the vendor and a ny delay(s) arising out of such non-compliance, shall be on vendor's account. . 5.
